First, I'll parse the SVG path data to determine the number of distinct points and the shape formed.

The path commands:
- M 49.56,30.61 (move to starting point)
- L 43.41,40.44 (line to)
- L 37.02,36.44 (line to)
- L 43.17,26.61 (line to)
- L 36.78,22.62 (line to)
- L 53.07,18.45 (line to)
- L 55.94,34.61 (line to)
- L 49.56,30.61 (line back to start)

Counting the points:
1. (49.56,30.61)
2. (43.41,40.44)
3. (37.02,36.44)
4. (43.17,26.61)
5. (36.78,22.62)
6. (53.07,18.45)

8. Back to (49.56,30.61)

This gives 7 distinct vertices before returning to the start, forming a closed polygon with 7 sides.

A 7-sided polygon is a heptagon.

Final answer: (B)
